svg.title: What does an AI researcher actually do?
svg.desc: Suppose training scores improve, but performance on new tasks stays flat. This is an illustrative research situation, not a reported experimental result. 1 Choose what matters. Why do the gains fail to transfer? Output: a justified research question. 2 Make the idea testable. Better data, or simply more training? Output: hypotheses and a test plan. 3 Run a discriminating test. Compare data choices at equal compute. Output: results that address the claim. 4 Improve the next investigation. Which lesson helps on a new task? Output: a lesson whose transfer is tested. Is the question worthwhile? Does the test support the claim? What did it cost, and does the improvement hold on a new task?

g.font-family: Arial, 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif
g.text: ONE EXAMPLE · FOUR RESEARCH CAPABILITIES
What does an AI researcher actually do?
Suppose training scores improve, but performance on new tasks stays flat.
This is an illustrative research situation, not a reported experimental result.
RESEARCH TASTE
1 Choose what matters
Why do the gains fail to transfer?
Check prior work and explain why resolving
this uncertainty would change a decision.
Output: a justified research question
QUESTIONS & HYPOTHESES
2 Make the idea testable
Better data, or simply more training?
State competing explanations and predict
what each would imply for a fair comparison.
Output: hypotheses and a test plan
RESEARCH EXECUTION
3 Run a discriminating test
Compare data choices at equal compute.
Use held-out tasks; record controls, uncertainty,
failed attempts, and reproducible evidence.
Output: results that address the claim
LEARNING FROM EXPERIENCE
4 Improve the next investigation
Which lesson helps on a new task?
Retain evidence and its limits; test whether
memory, skills, code, or training improve decisions.
Output: a lesson whose transfer is tested
EVALUATE EACH STEP
Is the question worthwhile? Does the test support the claim?
What did it cost, and does the improvement hold on a new task?
Evidence can change the question, the method, or the next project. Researchers can revisit any step.
